name: What kind of marketing strategies are typically used for luxury homes?

mainEntity.name: What kind of marketing strategies are typically used for luxury homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marketing for luxury homes extends beyond standard listings to include bespoke strategies designed to attract high-net-worth individuals. This often involves professional photography, drone footage, virtual tours, and custom property websites. Targeted digital campaigns, exclusive print advertising, and discreet outreach to an agent's private network are also common. Kelby Contreras employs a multi-faceted approach, leveraging the reach of Realty ONE Group Evolution to showcase properties effectively in competitive markets like Fort Lauderdale and Key Biscayne.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury home marketing uses professional visuals, digital campaigns, exclusive advertising, and agent networks to reach discerning buyers.
